failside_intro_mastery_7_rules: 1. Hook Loop (Clip #1 Teaser = Clip #1 Main Body Climax): Use the 1.3s climax of the very first post-Warning clip as Clip #1 of the Intro (0.00..1.30s) so when the Warning card ends (18.65s), the viewer immediately gets the full context/payoff of that exact crash.
2. Pre-VO Cold Open Shock: Hit the viewer with 1-2 immediate physical crashes/groans in the first 1.5s..2.8s before (or right around) the opening greeting.
3. Zero-Setup & Scream-Peak Hard Cut: Trim all teaser clips (0.8s..1.9s each) to start 0.3s..0.5s before impact and hard-cut right at the peak of the scream or crash (cliffhanger cut).

4. Call-and-Response Audio Weaving: Leave breathing windows between VO clauses so funny groans, airbag explosions, and screams answer the narrator's questions (e.g., 'laugh out loud?' at 11.8s immediately followed by the biker's 'Uhhh!' groan at 11.85s).

5. Camera-Hit Finale Jump-Scare: Make the final teaser clip right after 'Let's get started!' (15.22..16.95s) an object flying directly into the camera lens / windshield, using that impact to trigger the Zoom-Blur transition into the WARNING card.
6. Uncluttered Action Center: Keep the center of the frame 100% free of text overlays during teaser impacts so the viewer's eye locks onto the physical action.
7. Dynamic Text-Clause Slicing: Never hardcode segment counts (2..6+ segments); slice VO strictly according to the intro text's natural clauses and the timing of teaser impacts.

8. Bzac New 'Warning-Bridge Loop' (Final Teaser Clip = Main Body Clip #1): Place the cliffhanger crash of Main Body Clip #1 as the LAST teaser clip right before the WARNING card (e.g., 13.08s..14.85s), hard-cut at airbag/impact peak into the WARNING card (14.85s..16.12s), and immediately replay the full clip with resolution (*NO SERIOUS INJURIES*) at 16.12s.

9. Bzac New Mid-Video Spoken Subscribe CTA (~04:40) & Triple Meme Reaction Tag: Weave a conversational Subscribe CTA into the AI narrator track after a Green Glitch Static transition, and chain 2-3 sequential reaction meme SFX on awkward/dumbfounded endings.

style_reference.editorial_identity: Zero-VO, Fast-Paced Pure Fail & Slapstick Compilation (~84-89 clips in 7m15s..7m45s, ~5.2s-5.8s median clip duration)
core_principles: 1. Zero-Fluff Cold Open (00:00): Start immediately at 0.00s with a high-visual-shock, contagious-laughter clip (no long intro card, no AI narrator voiceover).

2. Ultra-Tight 5.5s Pacing (~10.2 clips/min): Mean duration 5.2s..6.0s (P25=3.5s, P75=7.5s, hard cap 12.0s). Enter 0.8s..1.8s before action onset, keep the full impact, and cut right at the peak of cameraman laughter.
3. Rhythmic Alternation: After any 8s..11s story clip, chain 2-3 rapid-fire 3.0s..5.0s impact clips to prevent viewer fatigue.

4. 2-Shot Punchline Zoom-In (Fail Time Signature): On clips with priceless facial reactions or aftermath messes (e.g., powder cannon to face, exploding pan), razor-split right after impact and punch in (150%..200% scale) on the subject's face for the final 1.5s..2.5s.

5. 2-Stage Acoustic Rescue for Silent/Weak Clips (A3 Foley + A4 Human Reaction/Wheeze Laugh): Never leave silent clips dead. Pair an exact-frame physical Foley/Impact SFX on A3 (slip, bonk, splash, crash) with a human reaction/wheeze-laugh SFX on A4 (+0.3s..0.8s after impact: teakettle-steam, Pfft-hahaha, ouch, oof, eek!).

blocks.ordering_rule: Keep ascending numerical order (01 -> 50), cut to fast 4-Beat Fail Time pacing (mean ~5.5s), preserve contagious cameraman laughter in Aftermath.

blocks.block: 3. Part 2 Silent Montage (Bonk-script-<N>/*.mp4 with silent/dead audio, e.g. 5-8 clips at tail)
blocks.ordering_rule: Group all silent Part 2 clips at the end of the timeline, mute A1 (Level=0), and layer dual-track comedy sound design (A3 setup/slip/environment + A4 impact/bonk/human reaction at exact climax offset).

V1_background_chain.note: Or Rotation=0, Uniform Scale=105..115% for clean vertical borders like Fail Time
Skip on clips containing readable text/signage

rules: Always pass sequenceName explicitly to avoid editing the wrong sequence when multiple projects/sequences are open.
Use direct HTTP POST to 127.0.0.1:47823/command in batch Python scripts instead of spawning hundreds of subprocesses, reducing 100-clip mutation time from ~4 minutes to <15 seconds.
Never use seq.overwriteClip for subclip placement without setting both V1 and A1 inPoint/outPoint/start/end atomically.

Before placing a V2 shield clip via add-to-timeline, call set-item-in-out with V1's exact inPointSeconds and outPointSeconds; add-to-timeline snapshots existing A1 audio nodeIds so A1 is never touched and A2 remains 100% empty.
